handoff: Owner comment authorizes dedicated branch, Windows MVP, tests/docs/PR; no merge or release

architecture.protection: Windows DPAPI CurrentUser, UI_FORBIDDEN, per-user/installation/profile entropy
architecture.files: Private LocalAppData directory: non-secret metadata JSON and separate binary DPAPI credential
architecture.selection: Explicit process-local, not restored on reboot; query profile/revision pinning
architecture.fallback: Existing environment only, explicit after managed catalog; no plaintext persistence fallback

windows_validation: Native DPAPI, independent-process restart, DACL and browser CRUD required in PR CI; final IDs/SHA in PR description
limitations: DPAPI is not protection against the same Windows user, administrator or SYSTEM
No SSO/multiuser authorization or forensic secure erasure
Windows cross-user denial is tested with identity/key/entropy corruption fixtures; no second OS account is impersonated
No merge, release, production change or real Oracle test performed
